ios.desc:
Welcome to MindNote, the simplest multimodal AI note taking app, designed to keep your ideas, thoughts, and memories organized and accessible wherever you go. Whether you're jotting down personal reflections, work, brainstorming ideas, or collaborating with others, MindNote offers everything you need to stay productive and creative. The app is ideal for students, researchers, entrepreneurs, working teams.

Tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TReffGavpro&t=43s

Key Features:

- Personalized Notes: Write and organize your notes just the way you like. Change colors, add media, and categorize them into custom groups for easy access.

- Speech-to-Text: Dictate your ideas with the built-in speech-to-text feature. Speak freely, and MindNote will convert your words into written text instantly.

- Text-to-Voice: Listen to your notes being read aloud with the text-to-voice feature. Perfect for multitasking or reviewing notes on the go.

- Smart Editing with AI prompts: Use AI prompts, in any language to improve, organize, and refine your notes. Translate content into multiple languages, reorganize text alphabetically, transforms to tables, summarize ideas, correct grammar, complete notes with AI and more all with a simple tap.

- Customizable Organization: Group your notes into folders, tag them, and set reminders to stay organized and never miss an important task or idea.

- Collaboration: share your notes with others and work together in real-time. Edit, comment, and collaborate seamlessly on shared projects.

- Embedded media (videos, images and sound).

- Export as .pdf, .csv, .doc, .docx

More Features Coming Soon:

- Offline mode
- Currently supporting ChatGPT and Gemini, more ML models to come.
- And much more!

Why MindNote?
MindNote is designed for people who want more than just a simple note-taking app. With its easy-to-use interface, customizable features, and powerful AI-assisted tools, it's your perfect partner for work, study, travel and personal life.

Stay productive, creative, and organized all in one place.

Privacy policy: https://www.mindnote.online/privacy
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Hello everyone, 
While I’m looking for my next PM role, I’m building an AI Notetaker. Currently, I’m looking for app testers for 2 weeks, and in return, I’ll test your app too! It is also free forever for the testers. The app is an AI notetaker.
Please follow the next steps :
1. Become a member of the Google group : mindnote@googlegroups.com 
2. Testers can join using Google Play on Android (only after joining the group)
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mindnote.app
Testers can join on the web (Only after joining the group)
https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.mindnote.app
Would love to hear your feedback—let me know if you’re interested!  
To know about the current features, product demo and so on:

Tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=okq_LZLbDfI  (First writing and then editing with AI in any language)

Website: https://www.mindnote.online
You can always send me a DM. Thank you and please

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/mindnote-ai-notetaking-app/id6757657079

All apps have paid users which is great but I hope to get more this week . The next stage would be for optimize some features for B2B and app some novelty features.

Any recommendations for scaling faster?
